# KPI reference

Every result frame `nagasim.api.run_model` / `nagasim.experiments.run_scenarios` return, and every column each one carries -- probed against `nagasim/models/job_shop_jackson.json` so a new KPI column fails this generation until it has a definition here.

## system

One row per metric (`Metric`, `Value` columns). Metrics observed on the probe run:

| Metric | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Time Unit` | The model's base time unit (`simulation.time_unit`); every duration without its own unit is already expressed in it. |
| `Simulation Time` | Length of the observed window (run end minus warm-up), in the model's time unit. |
| `Total Entities Created` | Entities with `creation_time >= warmup`, excluding one currently represented by a batch (`in_batch` set). |
| `Total Entities Completed` | Entities with `deletion_time is not None and >= warmup`. |
| `Avg Throughput Time` | Mean of `deletion_time - creation_time` over completed entities (link transfer time included). |
| `Throughput (per time unit)` | Completed entities divided by the observed simulation time. |
| `Avg WIP (Little)` | Little's-law estimate: throughput x average throughput time (not a measured time-average of live entities). |
| `Max Queue Length` | Largest queue length observed across every resource, resource set and store. |
| `Avg Queue Length` | Sum of the time-weighted average queue length across every resource, resource set and store. |
| `Avg Resource Usage %` | Mean utilization (busy time over scheduled/available capacity) across real resources only -- a resource set's own collector re-counts its members, so it is excluded here to avoid double counting. |
| `Total Resource Cost` | Sum of every real resource's busy + idle + per-use cost over the run. |
| `Total Entity Holding Cost` | Sum of every entity type's WIP holding cost accrued while entities were in the system. |
| `Total Cost` | Sum of cost attributed to this object/run (resource busy+idle+usage cost, or an entity's own accumulated cost, or the model-wide total). |
| `Cost per Completed Entity` | Total Cost divided by Total Entities Completed. |
| `Entity Log Truncated` | 1 if the entity log hit `simulation.entity_log_limit` and older records were dropped (counts/costs stay exact via streaming accumulators either way). |
| `Resource/Store Log Truncated` | 1 if any resource or store's bounded snapshot log dropped records (`config.LOG_HISTORY`); affects only the flat log sheets, not KPIs. |

A run can also emit one WARNING row, absent from the probe above because a healthy run never produces it:

| Metric | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Short Statistics Window %` | WARNING row, present only when it fires: the share of the intended post-warm-up horizon the statistics actually cover, when that is under 10%. The run drained at or just after the warm-up reset, so every other metric here is an average of almost nothing -- check the arrival blocks' `max_arrivals`, or lower the warm-up. |

## entity_summary

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Entity Type` | The entity type this row summarizes. |
| `Total Created` | Entities of this type created in the observed window. |
| `Total Completed` | Entities of this type completed in the observed window. |
| `Avg Time` | Mean throughput time for this entity type. |
| `Min Time` | Minimum throughput time for this entity type. |
| `Max Time` | Maximum throughput time for this entity type. |
| `Mode Time` | Most frequent throughput time (histogram mode); an event-sample statistic, not time-weighted. |
| `Mode Time %` | Share of observations at the modal throughput time. |
| `P95 Time` | 95th percentile of throughput time. |
| `P99 Time` | 99th percentile of throughput time. |
| `Std Time` | Sample standard deviation of throughput time (ddof=1). |
| `Avg Cost` | Mean total cost accumulated per entity of this type. |
| `Total Cost` | Sum of cost attributed to this object/run (resource busy+idle+usage cost, or an entity's own accumulated cost, or the model-wide total). |

## entity_log

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Entity ID` | The entity's identity counter value. |
| `Type` | The entity's type (`e_type`). |
| `Created At` | Simulation time the entity was created. |
| `Exited At` | Simulation time the entity was disposed (or None if still live at report time). |
| `Throughput Time` | `Exited At - Created At` (None while the entity is still live). |
| `In Batch` | Id of the batch entity currently representing this member, or null if not batched. |
| `Cost` | Total cost accumulated on this entity (usage + holding + model-assigned). |
| `Initial` | True for an entity the warm start injected at t=0 (`initial_state`), rather than one a CREATE block produced during the run. |
| `Agent` | "<Population>:<index>" for an entity with an agent (a CREATE block's `population`, or an agent's own "enter" action), else "" (H2). |

## resource_summary

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Resource` | The resource or resource set this row summarizes. |
| `Total Seizes` | Number of granted request units (a quantity-2 seize counts as 2), reset at warm-up. |
| `Usage % (snapshot)` | Busy time over the scheduled (available) capacity integral -- off-shift and failed time never dilutes it. |
| `Idle %` | Share spent holding no job. |
| `Scheduled Capacity Avg` | Time-average of capacity available after capacity schedules/failures. |
| `Down %` | Time-average of the resource's failure-active flag. |
| `Busy Cost` | Cost accrued while the resource was busy (`cost_busy` x busy time). |
| `Idle Cost` | Cost accrued while the resource was scheduled but idle (`cost_idle` x idle time). |
| `Usage Cost` | Cost accrued per seize (`cost_per_use` x seize count). |
| `Total Cost` | Sum of cost attributed to this object/run (resource busy+idle+usage cost, or an entity's own accumulated cost, or the model-wide total). |
| `Queue Length Avg` | Time-weighted average queue length. |
| `Queue Length Max` | Largest queue length observed (ignores zero-duration levels). |
| `Queue Length Mode` | Most frequent queue length (event-sample, not time-weighted). |
| `Queue Length Mode %` | Share of observations at the modal queue length. |
| `Queue Len P95` | 95th percentile of the queue-length event samples. |
| `Queue Len P99` | 99th percentile of the queue-length event samples. |
| `Queue Len Std` | Sample standard deviation of the queue-length event samples. |
| `Time in Queue Avg` | Mean wait time over completed acquisitions only (excludes requests still queued at report time). |
| `Time in Queue Avg (incl. waiting)` | Mean wait time including the censored wait of requests still queued at run end. |
| `Time in Queue Max` | Maximum wait time over completed acquisitions. |
| `Time in Queue Mode` | Most frequent wait time (event-sample). |
| `Time in Queue Mode %` | Share of observations at the modal wait time. |
| `Wait P95` | 95th percentile of completed wait times. |
| `Wait P99` | 99th percentile of completed wait times. |
| `Wait Std` | Sample standard deviation of completed wait times. |
| `Bottleneck Score` | `round(utilization * avg_queue_length, 2)`, a heuristic ranking, not a standard KPI. |
| `Bottleneck %` | 1 for the single highest-scoring resource with utilization >= 0.75, else 0. |

## user_summary

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Statistic` | The RECORD statistic's name (`stat_name`). |
| `Kind` | In `user_summary`, the statistic's kind: count, tally, time_between or time_persistent. In `cost_summary`, the cost's kind: `fixed` (evaluated once at run start, never prorated), `event` (accrued as entities pass a RECORD kind="cost", reset at the warm-up) or `peak` (a flow's Peak Rate times its `peak_price`). In `charging_summary`, `charge` or `swap`. |
| `Count` | Number of observations (count's running total count, or a tally's/time_between's observation count); NaN for time_persistent, which has no discrete observations. |
| `Value` | The metric's/statistic's value, in the unit its row/kind implies. |
| `Min` | Minimum observed value (tally/time_between only). |
| `Max` | Maximum observed value (tally/time_between), or the highest level reached (time_persistent). |
| `Std` | Sample standard deviation of observed values (tally/time_between only). |

## order_summary

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Order` | The order's id, as declared in the model's "orders" section. |
| `Entity Type` | The entity type this row summarizes. |
| `Sequence` | Name of the routing the order's entities follow, blank for none. |
| `Release` | When the order was released into the model, in the base time unit. |
| `Due` | The order's due date, an ABSOLUTE time in the base time unit. |
| `Quantity` | How many entities the order releases. |
| `Created` | Entities this order actually released (warm-started ones included). |
| `Completed` | Entities of this order disposed so far / due-dated entities of this type completed after the warm-up. |
| `Completion Time` | When the LAST entity of the order was disposed; NaN while it is incomplete. |
| `Lateness` | Signed `completion - due`: negative is early, positive is late. |
| `Tardiness` | `max(0, lateness)`: earliness does not offset lateness. |
| `Late` | 1 if the order missed its due date / count of late entities of this type. |
| `Status` | `complete` (finished after the warm-up, the only status the means count), `warmup` (finished before it) or `incomplete` (still in the system at run end). |

## due_date_summary

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Entity Type` | The entity type this row summarizes. |
| `Completed` | Entities of this order disposed so far / due-dated entities of this type completed after the warm-up. |
| `On Time` | Due-dated entities of this type completed with lateness <= 0. |
| `Service Level` | On Time / Completed -- the fraction delivered on time. |
| `Avg Lateness` | Mean signed lateness over this type's completed due-dated entities. |
| `Avg Tardiness` | Mean tardiness over the same entities (earliness counts as 0). |
| `Max Tardiness` | Worst tardiness seen for this entity type. |
| `Late` | 1 if the order missed its due date / count of late entities of this type. |

## queue_summary

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Block` | The SEIZE/PROCESS block the queue behaviour is declared on. |
| `Resource` | The resource or resource set this row summarizes. |
| `Balked` | Entities that saw the queue on arrival and never joined it. |
| `Reneged` | Entities that joined the queue and gave up before being served. |
| `Preempted` | Times a job of this block was interrupted by a higher-priority entity. |
| `Avg Wait Before Renege` | Mean time the entities that gave up had already waited. |
| `Max Wait Before Renege` | Longest wait before giving up. |
| `Changeovers` | Times this block's resource actually changed over -- the setup key differed from the previous job's. |
| `Setup Time` | Total time spent changing over at this block. It happens while the resource is held, so it is already inside its busy time and utilization. |

## motion_summary

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Motion` | `<block>/<kind>`: one segment kind of one MOTION block, or `<block>/cycle`. |
| `Block` | The SEIZE/PROCESS block the queue behaviour is declared on. |
| `Segment Kind` | move, pick, place, tool_change, dwell, process, or cycle for the whole cycle. |
| `Segments` | Segments of this kind completed (cycles, on the cycle row). |
| `Mean Time` | Mean duration of one segment of this kind (one cycle, on the cycle row), in the model's base unit. |
| `Total Time` | Summed duration of this kind's segments over completed cycles. |
| `Cycle Share %` | This kind's share of the total cycle time: the cycle-time breakdown. |
| `Collaborative %` | Of this block's moves, the share run at the collaborative speed (move row only). |

## charging_summary

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Charger` | The charger or battery-swap station this row summarizes. |
| `Kind` | In `user_summary`, the statistic's kind: count, tally, time_between or time_persistent. In `cost_summary`, the cost's kind: `fixed` (evaluated once at run start, never prorated), `event` (accrued as entities pass a RECORD kind="cost", reset at the warm-up) or `peak` (a flow's Peak Rate times its `peak_price`). In `charging_summary`, `charge` or `swap`. |
| `Points` | How many vehicles the charger serves at once. |
| `Sessions` | Charges or swaps completed, an interrupted opportunity charge included. |
| `Utilization %` | Share of the charger's point-time with a vehicle charging or swapping. |
| `Avg Wait` | Mean time from a vehicle's arrival to the start of its charge or swap (a wait for a charged pack included), in the model's base unit. |
| `Avg Queue` | Time-averaged number of vehicles waiting at the charger. |
| `Grid kWh` | Energy drawn from the grid: battery kWh / efficiency, booked when a session (or a swapped pack's recharge) ends. Also a row of `energy_summary`. |
| `Peak kW` | Highest total power of the batteries charging at once, the taper included. |
| `Energy Cost` | Total kWh x simulation.energy_price; 0 with no price set. Joins cost_summary (Kind "energy") and the system frame's Total Cost. |

## battery_summary

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Fleet` | The pool of vehicles this row summarizes. Its utilization, seize count and costs are in the RESOURCE frame -- a fleet is a resource; this frame adds what only a vehicle pool has. |
| `Capacity kWh` | One vehicle's battery capacity. |
| `Charging %` | Share of the fleet's total vehicle-time spent charging or swapping. |
| `Charge Trips` | Arrivals at a charger, summed over the vehicles. |
| `Min SoC` | Lowest state of charge any vehicle reached (0-1; negative after a depletion). |
| `Mean Final SoC` | Mean state of charge over the vehicles at the end of the run. |
| `Depleted` | Times a vehicle's state of charge crossed zero; it finishes its job regardless. |
| `Drain kWh` | Energy the vehicles drew from their batteries: `power` kW per state x time. |

## tending_summary

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Station` | The tending STATION this row summarizes, with the arm fleet in `Fleet`. A pair has a row once a cobot of the fleet has tended the station. |
| `Fleet` | The pool of vehicles this row summarizes. Its utilization, seize count and costs are in the RESOURCE frame -- a fleet is a resource; this frame adds what only a vehicle pool has. |
| `Picks` | Pick cycles completed: parts the fleet's cobots took out of the station. |
| `Places` | Place cycles completed: parts the cobots put into the station. |
| `Exchanges` | Visits on which a loaded cobot picked a finished part before placing its own (the fleet's `exchange`); each is also one pick and one place. |
| `Avg Pick Time` | Mean duration of a pick cycle, in the model's base unit. |
| `Avg Place Time` | Mean duration of a place cycle. |
| `Avg Loaded Wait` | Mean time a cobot held its part at the station, from its loaded arrival until the machine accepted the part (0 when the machine was free; an exchange's pick is inside it). |
| `Avg Blocked For Pick` | Mean time a finished part, and with it its machine, waited for a cobot: from the part reaching its TRANSPORT to the start of the pick cycle. |
| `Avg Stay` | Under `cobot: "stay"`: mean time the cobot waited at the station, from the end of its place cycle until the part reached its next TRANSPORT or a DISPOSE. |

## timeseries

| Column | Definition |
|---|---|
| `Run` | Replication index (0-based). |
| `Time` | Sample time on the fixed sampling grid. |
| `Series` | Which quantity this row samples, e.g. `system/WIP`, `resource/<name>/queue`, `store/<name>/size`, `user/<name>`, `level/<name>`, `agents/<population>/<state>`; for `dashboard`, the widget's series label (empty for a kpi/gauge widget). |
| `Value` | The metric's/statistic's value, in the unit its row/kind implies. |
| `Warmup` | True if this sample falls before the warm-up cutoff. |
